signal_evidence.services_demand: In Q1, view hours were up at a similar rate of growth to what we saw in 2025, despite having the Winter Olympics—17 days of robust streaming competition—land in Q1 as well.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: We will continue to ramp our investment—still small relative to overall content spend—based on demonstrated performance and growing returns... [plus Interpositive acquisition and accelerated M&A-related costs pulled forward into 2026].
signal_evidence.pricing_power: Netflix subscribers are paying the least per hour of viewing compared to other SVOD offerings—in some cases, you would have to pay two times per hour to get a competitive service.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: We have seen really good progress so far in this first quarter that builds on the solid momentum and results from 2025... we are maintaining our guidance and strong outlook.
